TICKET
# $this->action is null in postProcess method

$this->action is null in the first if block of the postProcess method in AdminController class.

This fact causes a PHP deprecation notice in PHP 8.1 stating that:

> ucfirst(): Passing null to parameter #1 ($string) of type string is deprecated

## Attendu
The expected behavior is calling all the hooks without any PHP notices or warnings.

## Étapes
1. Run your installation with PHP 8.1
2. Go to 'Modules and Services'
3. Check your error log
